english.name: German Heilpraktiker Licensing Exam (written part)
english.fullName: German Heilpraktiker licensing exam (Heilpraktikerüberprüfung), written part for the general licence, in German

notes: 3 tests x 60 = 180 (the real length: 60 questions in 120 minutes, 45 correct = 75 %), pools 200, the last items of each pool (20 in all) are training-only. Per test 7/7/5/7/5/7/6/6/4/6 (Tigertest's split along the BMG Leitlinien of 7 Dec 2017; no official weights). Training: five topic sets 22301-22305 (Recht+Infektionsschutz 48, Hygiene+Notfälle 36, Herz+Atmung 38, Stoffwechsel+Blut/Niere 42, Nerven/Psyche+Bewegung/Haut/Gyn/Päd 36) + 3 tests = 8 dashboard steps. Aussagenkombination items are single best answer; their options are self-contained ('Nur 1, 2 und 4'), so shuffling is safe.
